notes: Fixed bottom sheet content not scrolling on mobile. Root cause: @touchend and @touchcancel handlers on .bottom-sheet-content were registered without .passive modifier, causing iOS Safari to disable touch scrolling on the element. Fix: (1) Added .passive modifier to @touchend and @touchcancel in index.html template, (2) Added -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch to .bottom-sheet-content CSS for iOS momentum scrolling. All 1482+ existing tests pass with 0 failures.
